text: The lottery's own security director rigged the lottery. In five states.
Eddie Tipton. His whole job? Protect the computers that pick the numbers.
Instead, he later told a court, he wrote code to predict the winning numbers.
Hit like if you've always said it's rigged. Yeah.
Here's the payout plan. He said he gave the numbers to other people, who won and shared it with him.
Send this to your— to whoever in your family still plays every week.
Then the big one. A ticket hits a jackpot advertised at sixteen point five million.
How much got paid out? Follow, this page reads the court files.
Twenty seventeen, he pleads guilty. The sentence? Up to twenty-five years.
So… still trust the lottery? Yes or no.
